Name: HTT Japan - Silo
Author: Otterhead
Description:
[center][size=6]星の[/size][size=6]露[/size][size=6]の谷[/size]
[size=5]Hoshi no Tsuyu no Tani (HTT)
[/size][size=3] ⁂ Valley of the Dew of the Star ⁂[/size][/center]
[size=3]Here's the [/size][size=4]farm silo[/size][size=3] for you all - I had it completed last year and got bogged down by a new job... so forgot to post it. Hope you all enjoy it! The mod includes [/size][i]seasonal variations[/i][size=3] and an [/size][i]inclement weather variation[/i][size=3] that closes the silo door during Spring/Summer/Fall under many common weather tags. If I missed one let me know!

[size=3]My HTT mods are typically based off real life buildings in Japan. [/size][size=3]The silo is based off kura (storehouses) from the [url=https://enjoyniigata.com/en/spot/5559]Northern Culture Museum/Ito Estate in Niigata[/url] and the [/size][url=https://www.tokyoartbeat.com/en/venues/-/gallery-kura][size=3]Gallery KURA[/size][/url][color=#f1f1f1][size=3] in Tokyo, Japan.
[/size][/color][/size]
_____

[size=3]A note on the sprite inspirations for my mods: There are open permissions from the "Seasonal Japanese Buildings" original creator [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3947][size=3]S[/size][size=3]onreirblah[/size][/url][size=3] because they are no longer working on the initial mod at all, and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Leroymilo/about-me?gameId=1303]Leroymilo[/url] was kind enough to give permission for me to use whatever they had also added on to the mod when they updated it for 1.6. use.[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]
[b][i][i]I create my visual mods digitally by hand out of a desire to share my love of Japanese architecture and aesthetics, and do not condone the use of AI in creative works like images, visual design, graphic design, etc. AI is a tool that should be used sparingly, responsibly, and ethically.[/i][/i][/b]

_____

[size=3][size=5]Install[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher if you don't already have it[/url].
[*]Download this HTT mod and unzip/extract it into "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[/size]

[list]

[/list]
